dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Visible narrowing of the 2D silhouette from the mid-section toward the caudal region, maintaining a relatively consistent rate of decrease in pixel width.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Distinct asymmetrical lateral bulge on the left side of the mid-body margin; the right margin appears more streamlined with minimal deviation.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey skin tone baseline; median pixel intensity is significantly higher than neonate slate-grey but below the saturation level of mature white.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: High density of dark-grey residual clusters; one large complex patch located on the mid-dorsal surface and a secondary isolated patch on the posterior dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Sharp gradient transition between the pigmented dark-grey clusters and the lighter depigmented baseline canvas.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive butterfly-shaped dark-grey pigmentation mark situated centrally on the dorsal axis.
